role: Implementation of the community-monitoring contract (huikoeaina docs/contracts/community-monitoring.md): the monitoring record schema, validator, intake, forms, and build that consumers run in their own repositories and CI. Publishes nothing itself; holds no registry of record. Governed by huikoeaina's contract pen; ruled 2026-10-12 (mokunet-org change 2026-10-12-community-monitoring-toolkit).

provides.surface: dist/registry/<program>.published.json — the published-manifest projection a consumer's build emits: every listed record with gated fields (story, outcomes) stripped unless published, submitter contact never; shape per community-monitoring.md §6, row source for mokulearner-node's planned /api/services/community/outcomes
provides.note: 0.1.0 emits the kuleana-portal v0.3 projection unchanged (compat check: byte-for-byte against the Green Fee Commons Report). The contract's §2 shape lands in 0.2 behind a compatibility profile. Consumers declare once the projection is in the contract's shape; kuleana is the first, in its own manifest, when it pins the toolkit.

consumes.expects: docs/contracts/community-monitoring.md — record shape (§2), program document (§3), mapping rules (§4), publication gate (§5), outputs (§6); shapes change there first, then here, then in consumers
consumes.note: Contract proposed 2026-10-12, ratification owed by huikoeaina (its §7 open items: moku key form, cross-moku list, outcomes-update path, training-role mapping). 0.1.0 implements the pre-contract v0.3 shape it was lifted with; 0.2 implements §2.

acknowledges.note: Repository created 2026-10-12 under the steward's final name; manifest seeded; 0.1.0 = gates lifted from kuleana-portal with the compat check. Owed elsewhere: repo-enum value (mokulearner-node), §7 rows (mokunet-org).
